text_block_list.text: —The day of the second Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, Yamanin Zephyr... What an incredible lineup we have this year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, wait!
You forgot Nishino Flower-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
Man, it really feels like her expression has changed
compared to how she used to be...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of growth she'll show us today.
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me...
those usual words of yours?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask for a selfish favor?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become a great, blooming flower.
And when I do...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want you to praise me and say it looks pretty...!
